scope: Owned signed-in WebView2 browser. Complete bounded release batches, anonymous-account separation, cancellations and session-reset rejection. No public network or downloads.
nativeEnvironment: Windows x64 Rust dev build, actual WebView2 manager, separate noninteractive Windows desktop and temporary browser account storage

fixture.authentication: Owned loopback service issued an HTTP-only cookie to the selected account. Its sign-in view remained open during the inventory and interruption checks.
fixture.identityCheck: Every filename and SHA-256 of the watch URL, separator and exact source-file identity matched independently constructed values.
fixture.replacement: The interrupted release used 641 distinct replacement URLs with different names. The original offer IDs and keys remained visible and could not authorize opening a download.

bounds.publication: Atomic after all rows, navigation, session and operation ownership are verified.
